coarse_skill_concept: Configure, patch, and compile C/C++ or system-level software from source using make/cmake/gcc, resolving toolchain errors, missing dependencies, and platform-specific build issues.

task_judgments.reason: Patches Windows-specific headers and struct definitions then uses cmake to build the library — textbook patch-and-compile workflow.
Fetches Debian sources, edits Makefile to strip X11 flags, and runs make — canonical configure/patch/build procedure.
Downloads old C archives, applies multiple sed patches for modern compiler compatibility, and builds with a legacy make file.
cmake configure with a missing-header patch, then make install — straightforward C++ toolchain task.
The terminal configure+make step is covered, but the dominant challenge is setting up opam/OCaml/Coq — a fundamentally different toolchain the candidate skill does not address.
Building Caffe with cmake and OpenCV API patches is fully covered, but training a neural network and validating accuracy is a separate ML-domain requirement.
Compiling TCC with static linking is squarely in the skill, but packaging into an ISO and integrating with QEMU requires a distinct procedure.
gcc is invoked indirectly via Cython/setuptools, but the real challenge is Python packaging and NumPy 2.x API compatibility — not C/C++ toolchain errors.
Applies a source patch then drives make defconfig and make — standard compile-from-source procedure, just for a kernel target.
No compilation from source occurs; the task is entirely about constructing a CPIO initramfs from pre-built busybox binaries.

final_groups.skill_concept: Configure, patch, and compile C/C++ or system-level software from source using make/cmake/gcc, resolving toolchain errors, missing dependencies, and platform-specific build issues.
final_groups.reasoning: All seven tasks require the same iterative loop: obtain source, configure the build system (cmake/make/direct Makefile), apply sed/patch fixes for compiler or API incompatibilities, resolve linker/header errors, and produce a working binary. Even the PARTIAL tasks (caffe-cifar-10, build-tcc-qemu) have the C/C++ build step as a major, non-trivial component that the skill directly serves.
